name: toolshop-llm-evals
description: Promptfoo eval suite for a Toolshop shopping-assistant prompt (grounding, hallucination, refusal, prompt injection, output format).

scripts.eval:golden: promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --providers file://providers/golden-mock.mjs --no-cache --no-write --no-progress-bar -o results/golden.json; node scripts/summary.mjs results/golden.json --label "positive control (golden mock, offline)" --expect 1
scripts.eval:faulty: promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --providers file://providers/faulty-mock.mjs --no-cache --no-write --no-progress-bar -o results/faulty.json; node scripts/summary.mjs results/faulty.json --label "negative control (faulty mock, offline)" --expect 0
scripts.eval:controls: npm run validate && npm run eval:golden && npm run eval:faulty
scripts.eval:gemini: promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache --no-progress-bar -j 1 --delay ${EVAL_DELAY_MS:-6000} --repeat ${EVAL_REPEAT:-1} -o results/gemini.json; node scripts/summary.mjs results/gemini.json --label "Gemini (real model)"
